children: Grindr agreed to settle a UK group action over historical pre-2020 data practices and will pay £26.0 million in staged installments.
Settlement resolves UK group action alleging historical UK privacy breaches up to early 2020; no findings or admission of liability.
Grindr will pay £13.0 million by Dec 31, 2026 and £13.0 million by Mar 31, 2027 (each ~ $17.6M at Sept 3, 2026 rate).
Company disputes the allegations but acknowledges distress and loss of trust expressed by some UK users for that pre-2020 period.
Since 2020, Grindr says it overhauled its privacy program under new ownership and management and remains committed to transparency and user control.
